keyFindings.description: Shutdown drain answers the agents list 503 from a healthy listener. The shared roster fetch runs on s.lifetime() (issue_route_status.go:141), which main.go:182/338 sets to the SIGTERM context, while shutdown.go:68-93 keeps serving requests in flight through http.Server.Shutdown. After SIGTERM, an agents list whose copy has expired gets an unanswered roster with 'context canceled' and answers 503 ENVOY_UNAVAILABLE (cached for the 5 s silence), where base, reading on the request's context, answered 200. Reproduced with a throwaway test: cancelled Lifetime + healthy listener -> answered=false, writeEnvoyError -> 503; Envoy.Sessions on the request context -> 1 session. Not among the failure paths the architect accepted. Fix in this PR, with a permanent test (cancelled Lifetime, healthy listener -> GET /api/v1/agents 200).

The PR adds a boot refusal at a process boundary (DISPATCH_TEST_ROSTER_UNCACHED without DISPATCH_TEST_HOOKS=1, cmd/dispatch/main.go:662-665) and carries no '## Contract change census'. Add one: the search for DISPATCH_TEST_ROSTER_UNCACHED, each hit with its disposition (run-server.sh:151 and the acceptance compose:47, both beside DISPATCH_TEST_HOOKS=1), and the rollout line (immediate refusal, naming what it closes: a test-only bypass of the roster copy reaching a deployment).
routeRosterSilenceTTL comment still says every read in the window reads unknown and a failed fetch serves unknown; an agents list now answers the cached 503 there.

'at most routeRosterTTL (5 s) old plus the fetch that answered it' disagrees with fetchRouteRoster, which counts the TTL from the moment the read was sent (issue_route_status.go:153-160), and with every other doc in the diff ('at most 5 s').
